verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms a licensed Bitbucket Data Center/Server edition exists, which implies a self-managed instance. However, it appears only in the context of migrating to Cloud, with no documentation on installing, configuring, upgrading, or maintaining it on your own infrastructure. Private runners cover CI execution only, not hosting the instance itself, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit statement that Data Center runs on customer infrastructure, install/configuration docs, upgrade and maintenance docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can install, configure, upgrade, and maintain my own instance on my infrastructure

citations.quote: Sign up for a free Bitbucket Cloud Premium trial for the same user count and duration as your Bitbucket Data Center license.
Our free migration app automates moving your code and users from Bitbucket Server or Data Center to Bitbucket Cloud.
